notes.title: Update 6: (New) New Hire Onboarding
notes.notes:
Exciting News — The Atlas Problem free public demo is now available as part of Update 6: (New) New Hire Onboarding!

All employees are expected to refresh their corporate training with this new and improved onboarding experience. Some things to look forward to include:

Shorter overall training time
Better access to workplace equipment
Updated employee collection goals
More intuitive interfaces to speed up acclimation


We hope you enjoy this updated onboarding program, and if you don't, always remember:
AMOS is your colleague. AMOS is your friend. AMOS is always watching.

[hr][/hr]
Update Patch Notes
New Player Experience

Enhanced Tutorial System: Comprehensive tutorial overhaul with visual guides and step-by-step imagery (more to come on this front)
Streamlined Introduction: Reduced introduction length for a more exciting starting experience

Gameplay & Balance

New Weapon: Introduced the "Fragmenter" shotgun for close-range debris destruction
Taller Wall Structures: Updated wall structure available for enhanced base defense; less worry about debris flying over your defenses!
Anomaly Encounter Adjustments: Significant balance changes and improvements to the debris anomaly encounters
New Steam Achievements: Additional achievement milestones added

UI & Visuals

Major interface Overhaul: Dramatically improved user interface across all game systems
Enhanced Redirector Display: Redirector structures now clearly show direction indicators and launch range
Weather Status Display: Current weather conditions now visible in the main UI
Enhanced Weather Systems: Improved weather effect rendering and visual quality
Ambient Effects Upgrade: Overall improvements to environmental and atmospheric visual effects throughout the station

Audio & Sound

Expanded Sound Effects: Added comprehensive audio feedback for player interactions throughout the game
Improved Audio Controls: Enhanced audio settings with better volume mixing and control options

Accessibility

Expanded Subtitles: Additional subtitle support across more game systems and audio cues
Voice Skip Feature: Press Z to skip voiceover sequence



[hr][/hr]
Station Managers are advised to update their systems immediately. Report any anomalies to your designated AI supervisor.

notes.title: Update 5: Mandatory Overtime
notes.notes:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3064620/0eaa92c0b63f49b6ed06846b56e2a9f8dbca5bbc/header.jpg?t=1746035971
UPDATE 5: MANDATORY OVERTIME
Using the new [color=#ff9900]Research & Development Lab[/color], expand your array of structures, abilities, and technologies to be more efficient at collecting critical resources! In particular, the new [color=#ff9900]Loadout Kit Tool[/color] and [color=#ff9900]Scanning Array[/color] will allow Station Managers to optimally strategize around that day's wave patterns and [color=#ff9900]Space Weather™[/color].

[hr][/hr]
New in Update 5:

 Refined tutorial phase to help new Station Managers get started
 Fully implemented base building and resource collection
 A wide variety of definitely-harmful, sometimes-helpful weather patterns to strategize around
 Early implementation of the progression and loadout systems
 A little bit of space mystery to discover
 Tech tree, project management, and loadout system for changing your strategy between waves and lives
 Enhanced resource collection mechanics
 Optimized drone AI behavior
 Expanded buildable structures
 Various bug fixes and performance optimizations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078036/a67a882dc37bf7fec975c501c6519d2f11185257.gif

[hr][/hr]
PLAYTEST EXPANSION
Alongside this update, we're expanding our playtest program to welcome more Station Managers to Atlas!

How to join:
Simply request access through the "Request Access" button on this page. We're processing applications regularly and will be admitting new Station Managers in batches. All playtesters will receive regular updates with new content and features as development progresses. Your feedback during this crucial stage will directly influence the evolution of Atlas Problem.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078036/7e494793c1a0a91ad9b7b40117c2831ee1b77b5f.gif

[hr][/hr]
YOUR FEEDBACK MATTERS
As we enter this new phase of development, your feedback is more valuable than ever. Share your thoughts through our Discord server where you can chat directly with the developers.

We're particularly interested in hearing about your experience with the new weather system, the resource balancing, and which aspects of the game you found most engaging.

See you on Atlas!

notes.title: The Work From Home* Update
notes.notes:
*(*your home away from home, i.e., your work)*

Greetings, Station Managers

We're pleased to announce that Update 4 for The Atlas Problem has been deployed and is now available for all playtesters. This major update introduces the Employee Journal and Handbook, new structures, and significant quality-of-life improvements to [strike]improve your performance[/strike] enhance your experience on Atlas.

What's New in Update 4:

- Employee Journal and Handbook: Your comprehensive guide to life on Atlas, including jukebox controls, a structures database, and tutorial tips so you can revisit what you've learned
- New Introduction Scene: A proper welcome to your new home away from home
- Welding Torch: New repair tool replaces the old repair hotkey
- New Structures: Point Defense Cannon, Redirector, and Wall to enhance your base defenses
- Numerous Quality-of-Life Improvements: Updated UI, more intuitive resource collection, clearer interactions, and a lot more
- 🎂

Update 4 is available now in the beta branch, and will be available by default on Monday, March 10th.

📋 [View the complete patch notes here]

As this is still a playtest beta, we're particularly interested in your feedback on the new systems, QOL elements, and structures. Please share your experiences, bug reports, and suggestions on our Discord server.

Thank you for your continued support as we develop Atlas Problem!

*—The Atlas Problem Development Team*
